blocks.x: Agentic AI & Hyperautomation for Omnichannel Retail — digital workers, decision hubs and self-healing workflows — governed autonomy at enterprise scale applied to the omnichannel retail operating unit of Retail & Consumer Goods.

Omnichannel retail wins on promise-keeping: availability, delivery promise, price consistency and service resolution across channels. The decision infrastructure behind those promises — demand sensing, allocation, pricing — decides margin before marketing spends a cent.

items: Store/DC allocation on legacy rules; phantom availability coexists with overstock.
Forecasts update weekly while baskets shift daily; markdowns and stockouts both inherit the lag.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Hyperautomation & Systems Integration, Digital Workforce & Multi-Agent Orchestration, Hyperautomation & Systems Integration from the Agentic AI & Hyperautomation tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Demand sensing and pricing, Allocation/replenishment, Order promise and fulfillment) on KYC Management System and EEMS Platform and Driisti Smart Vision Glasses. Governance inherits the sector frame — GDPR/CCPA among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Agents that execute the work — tool-using, policy-bounded, and replayable for audit.
Hundreds of agents as one governed fleet — roles, queues, budgets and audit for the AI workforce.
Enterprise decisions in milliseconds — decision hubs with policy, evidence and replay built in.
size-curve and DC logic proposed to planners (OOS and overstock both down)
